name: Delhi
tagline: Imperial History and Modern Energy at Incredible Value
description: Delhi is India's sprawling capital, a megacity where Mughal monuments stand alongside gleaming malls and a world-class metro system. The cost of living is astonishingly low by Western standards, and the city offers some of the best food, healthcare, and cultural experiences in South Asia. Air quality and traffic congestion are real challenges, but for FIRE seekers who can look past them, Delhi delivers unmatched bang for the buck.

quickFacts.visa: India has no retirement, pension, or passive-income visa. US citizens use the e-Tourist visa — 30-day (multiple-entry) or 1-year/5-year (multiple-entry; the 5-year fee rose from $80 to $200 in 2026) — and may stay up to 180 days per visit, with total time capped at 180 days per calendar year; long-term residents get by cycling visas in and out. The only path to living in India indefinitely is the OCI card, open to people of Indian origin or those married 2+ years to an Indian citizen or OCI holder.
quickFacts.safetyRating: Moderate – exercise normal caution; avoid isolated areas at night
quickFacts.climate: Subtropical with extreme summers and cool winters

housing.description: Modest furnished 1BHK builder-floor in a safe South-Delhi pocket (Malviya Nagar/Saket) or good Dwarka

dining.description: Cheap local eats, tiffin service, occasional restaurant

healthcare.description: Individual ₹10 lakh mediclaim (Star/Niva Bupa/HDFC ERGO) — assumes an early retiree (45–55); older retirees should budget more

entertainment.description: Streaming, monuments, Lodi Garden, occasional cinema

1M.lifestyle: A dignified budget, not a survival floor — a private 1BHK in a decent, safe South-Delhi colony, home cooking with cheap street/thali meals, metro-first mobility, and real individual health cover. Comfortable, with almost no discretionary fat. Winter air quality and summer A/C are the real costs of living here.

housing.description: Spacious 3BR apartment in Greater Kailash, Vasant Kunj, or a modern Gurgaon high-rise

dining.description: Regular dining at Khan Market restaurants, Hauz Khas cafes, and Old Delhi food tours

healthcare.description: Premium insurance covering Apollo, Medanta, and other top-tier hospitals

transportation.description: Own small car or regular Uber/Ola; metro for convenience

entertainment.description: Theatre at National School of Drama, art galleries, gym membership, weekend trips to Agra and Jaipur

2M.lifestyle: A spacious apartment in Greater Kailash or a modern Gurgaon high-rise, dining at Khan Market restaurants and Hauz Khas cafes several times a week, and your own car or regular Uber. Premium health insurance covering Apollo and Medanta hospitals. Weekend trips to Agra and Jaipur are affordable. Day-to-day life is comfortable and you have a solid financial cushion each month.

housing.description: Good 1BHK / compact 2BHK in a prime South-Delhi colony (Greater Kailash, Defence Colony) or a serviced Gurgaon high-rise

healthcare.description: ₹50L–₹1cr base + super-top-up (top-ups are cheap in India)

transportation.description: Own small car (running cost) or frequent Uber/Ola

3M.lifestyle: Comfortable living with real margin — a well-located flat in a leafy prime colony, eating out several times a week, a strong ₹1cr insurance stack, and either a car or unlimited ride-hail. Weekend Himalayan/Rajasthan getaways and a gym are baked in.

housing.description: Grand bungalow in Lutyens' Delhi zone or ultra-luxury penthouse in Gurgaon

dining.description: Personal chef for daily meals, fine dining several times per week, catered events

healthcare.description: VIP concierge medical with dedicated physician; international hospital access

transportation.description: Luxury sedan with full-time chauffeur, domestic flights, occasional chartered travel

entertainment.description: Premium club memberships, polo matches, art collecting, luxury Himalayan retreats

domesticHelp.description: Full-time cook, housekeeper, driver, gardener, and part-time personal assistant

luxuryExtras.description: First-class international travel, luxury resort stays, philanthropy, property investments

5M.lifestyle: A large bungalow or penthouse in a premium area, a luxury car with full-time driver, and a housekeeper, cook, and gardener. Regular dining at Delhi's top restaurants and business class flights for longer trips. Premium healthcare with a dedicated physician. Delhi's low costs relative to this budget mean a very large monthly margin, even living at the top end of the market.

housing.description: Large 3BHK builder-floor in Defence Colony/GK/Jor Bagh or a luxury Gurgaon tower

dining.description: Fine dining several times a week, hotel restaurants

domesticHelp.description: Full-time cook + housekeeper scaled to ONE home (not estate staff)

10M.lifestyle: Genuine luxury — a large flat in the most prestigious colonies, a driver, a full-time cook/housekeeper, top international health cover, and a fine-dining/travel budget. Honestly capped by what the market can absorb: even prime Delhi rents, dining, and staff cannot soak up this budget without waste, so expect a large monthly surplus.
